articles.summary: TEJON RANCH, Calif., April 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tejon Ranch Co., or the Company, (NYSE: TRC), a diversified real estate development and agribusiness company, today announced it will release its first quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on May 7, 2026.
articles.title: Tejon Ranch Co. Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
